justification: Holy cow, folks, lineup card time! Rodgers, Bijan, and Likely are the hottest bats in the whole dang clubhouse right now -- Likely went for near 27 last week, Bijan's a man possessed, no way I'm touching 'em. Now I gotta be a good skipper and own up to a couple things: my fella Deebo Samuel's tagged Out, so I'm pulling Stefon Diggs up off the bench into that WR2 spot -- a little Questionable tag never scared Harry Caray, a little rain never hurt anybody, folks! And Aaron Jones, bless him, Minnesota's got the week off so there's no ballgame for the man to play in -- can't very well leave an empty seat in the FLEX when Hunter Henry's standing right there healthy and ready, so Henry trots in. Zay Flowers, Swift, and the Ravens D ride right along same as always, and whoever's manning that kicker spot, well, we dance with who brung us. This is the marquee matchup of the week, Ed Monix and his Flint Tropics across the way -- clear eyes, full hearts, let's play some ball!
forum_post: WELL HOLY COW folks, swapped a BYE and an Out tag outta my lineup same mornin' and still feel great about it -- Diggs and Henry off the bench, Bijan and Likely still slingin' it, and I got my eye square on Ed Monix and that Flint Tropics crew of his this week! Caleb's a Chicago boy and you know I love him for it, but my Swift's wearin' the Bears colors too and he's runnin' downhill, buddy. Marquee game of the week right here, clear eyes, full hearts, let's play ball!
